correctness.rationale: For every nontrivial odd-order rotation, graph-edge orbits crossing vertex cycles are matchings of length at least 3, while internal edge orbits are unions of odd cycles with cover number at least ceil(order/2); hence no invariant nonempty face unless the order is exactly 3. In order 3, there are exactly m/3 invariant triangle simplices, with positive signed chain trace. The augmented simplicial Lefschetz trace is -1 or m/3−1. Known homology concentration and known H4 four-set permutation character give exact H3 traces, and the cyclic discrete Fourier transform yields each eigenvalue multiplicity. The independent verifier exactly tests orbit and small signed-chain cases plus integer multiplicities, and numerically checks reconstruction. The infinite proof does not rely on the finite tests.

value.rationale: The theorem determines the full cyclic-group homology module, not merely ranks, for an unbounded natural family that is the two-subset Čech case motivating recent homotopy research. It identifies a genuine exceptional order-three trace and all eigenvalue multiplicities, yielding exact invariant dimensions and quotient rational cohomology at every odd size. The required invariant graph-edge-orbit classification is a structural topological calculation; the result is neither a finite arbitrary slice nor a restatement of the known four-subset degree-four character.
